text.p: The Selection Details view displays information about the currently selected Actor in the main view. The information displayed include among others timing, fragmentation and any events that have occurred. Property values for the selected instance, as well as actor average, minimum and maximum values. Double-clicking on a maximum or minimum value scrolls the main view to show the corresponding instance in the trace.
The Selection Details view displays information about the currently selected Actor and event in the main view, for example scheduling priority.
More information is provided if using Percepio Profile or Percepio Tracealyzer, including timing metrics for the selected instance and average, minimum and maximum observed values for the actor.
